name: IRPC Public Company Limited
summary: IRPC Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in petroleum and petrochemical business in Thailand, Singapore, and internationally. It offers refinery, lubricant, asphalt, olefins, aromatics, and other petrochemical products; liquefied petroleum gas, naphtha, gasoline, diesel, and Jet A-1 commercial aviation fuel; and high density polyethylene, polypropylene, acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene, acrylonitrile styrene, polystyrene, and expandable polystyrene. The company also offers port services and storage tank services; water based products; ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene; acetylene black; and power and public utilities services.
